description:
Create a new security configuration in GeoServer. 

1. Log in to the GeoServer Web Admin interface (http://localhost:8080/geoserver/web/) with username 'admin' and password 'Admin123!'.
2. Create a new Role named 'ROLE_DATA_ANALYST'.
3. Create a new User named 'analyst_jones' with password 'Analyst2024!'. Ensure the user is enabled.
4. Assign the 'ROLE_DATA_ANALYST' role to the user 'analyst_jones'.
5. Verify the new user works by testing authentication against the REST API (e.g., accessing http://localhost:8080/geoserver/rest/about/version.json). Save the HTTP status code of your test (e.g., '200') to a file named '/home/ga/auth_test_result.txt'.
